text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The annual Summer Training Camp is about 
to begin once again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian hears from Air Groove that 
Biwa Hayahide will be joining them midway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove mentions "detailed 
examinations" as the reason, but avoids 
going into details. Narita Brian senses a 
faint sense of unease.
